---
title: "NHANES Sample Snapshot"
author: "Farnaz"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme: flatly
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, flexdashboard, here)

nhanes_data <- read_csv(
  here("datasets", "cleaned_NHANES.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    readings_available = rowSums(
      !is.na(across(starts_with("systolic_bp_")))
    ),
    avg_sbp = rowMeans(
      across(starts_with("systolic_bp_")),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    avg_sbp = if_else(
      readings_available == 0,
      NA_real_,
      avg_sbp
    )
  )

adult_percent <- mean(nhanes_data$age >= 21, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
high_sbp_percent <- mean(nhanes_data$avg_sbp > 120, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
```

Row {data-height=650}
-------------------------------------

### Week 3 age distribution

```{r age-figure}
knitr::include_graphics(
  here("graphics", "farnaz_age_density.png")
)
```

Row {data-height=350}
-------------------------------------

### Participants age 21 or older

```{r adult-gauge}
gauge(
  round(adult_percent, 1),
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  symbol = "%",
  sectors = gaugeSectors(
    success = c(60, 100),
    warning = c(40, 60),
    danger = c(0, 40),
    colors = c("#27AE60", "#F39C12", "#C0392B")
  )
)
```

### Average SBP above 120 mmHg

```{r sbp-value}
valueBox(
  value = paste0(round(high_sbp_percent, 1), "%"),
  caption = "Participants with average SBP above 120",
  icon = "fa-heartbeat",
  color = "warning"
)
```
